title: Line sketch: Cosmic Fragmented Face
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The subject is an abstract human face assembled from bold geometric shapes including circles, triangles, and arcs in contrasting colors. Composition centers the divided face within a large circle, encircled by radiating lines, celestial forms, and angular motifs on a ground. Technique employs flat color fields, sharp edges, and graphic outlines for a precise modernist effect (derived from painting #130).
